svg.title: Eventiva layer 2, group 3
svg.desc: Prerequisite arrows point toward dependent issues. Layers are derived, not approved dates. Labels and border patterns distinguish completed, current, upcoming, closed and blocked work. Every node links to its live issue; Markdown provides full titles, prerequisites and unlocks.
svg.text: Derived layers; not deadlines or acceptance.
Blocked overrides fill/border; current keeps double.

a.aria-label: EVE-252: Implement Effect Cluster sharding and multi-runner recovery in the fresh Eventiva backend. CURRENT / BLOCKED. Captured Linear: In Progress. 2 prerequisites; 1 unlocks. Layer 2.

a.aria-label: EVE-258: Add the database-neutral Resources API and privileged tenant migration adapter. CURRENT. Captured Linear: In Progress. 2026-11-17: later-status: Slice 1 adds a separate self-asserting declaration migration process-loss target to storage test, preserving the held parent spec and its migrationCrashProof:false default report. SQLite and disposable PostgreSQL pass precommit SIGKILL rollback, postcommit acknowledgement loss, empty repeat history, valid changed-prefix refusal and stale-writer rejection with a current-writer control. This is bounded local G04 evidence, not power loss, distributed fencing, native execution, production least privilege or whole-issue acceptance. Source capture remains historical; later execution and delivery evidence is cited separately. Sources: https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-258/add-the-database-neutral-resources-api-and-privileged-tenant-migration#comment-79bf922f, https://ampcode.com/threads/T-a0a1608d-284c-46c6-8bd0-372ce1a02efb. 2 prerequisites; 3 unlocks. Layer 2.
